'''Overcharged''' is the name of two [[Engineering Blueprints|Engineering Blueprints]]: one for [[Power Plant|Power Plants]] and one for several conventional weapon families. Both trade efficiency for higher output, but their modifiers, materials, Engineers, and compatible [[Experimental Effects]] are separate. A pinned Overcharged Blueprint for one module family does not apply to another.

== Power Plant Blueprint ==

The Power Plant version increases power generation while reducing module integrity and worsening heat efficiency.<ref name="power">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/13/ Power Plant – Overcharged], INARA, accessed 16 September 2026.</ref> In Elite Dangerous, a positive heat-efficiency modifier is a penalty: it increases the plant's heat-per-unit-power value.

Overcharged is appropriate when the fitted modules exceed the plant's unmodified output and the deficit cannot be solved acceptably through power priorities, lower-consumption modules, or another plant. Its heat and integrity penalties affect the whole build, so the lowest grade that closes the power deficit is often preferable to automatically applying Grade 5.

Compatible Power Plant Experimental Effects include [[Double Braced]], Monstered, [[Stripped Down]], and [[Thermal Spread]]. Only one Experimental Effect may be installed.

== Weapon Blueprint ==

The weapon version increases damage while increasing distributor draw and thermal load.<ref name="weapon">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/57/ Multi-cannon – Overcharged], INARA, accessed 16 September 2026.</ref> On [[Multi-Cannon|Multi-Cannons]], it also reduces clip size. The damage and operating-cost modifiers scale as follows:

=== Compatibility ===

Current Engineering records list the weapon version for:

* [[Beam Laser|Beam Lasers]], [[Burst Laser|Burst Lasers]], and [[Pulse Laser|Pulse Lasers]];
* [[Cannon|Cannons]];
* [[Fragment Cannon|Fragment Cannons]];
* [[Multi-Cannon|Multi-Cannons]];
* [[Plasma Accelerator|Plasma Accelerators]].

Available grades depend on both the weapon family and Engineer. The relevant module article and Engineer record should be checked before travelling for a high-grade modification.

Overcharged is a direct damage choice for a build that can supply the increased weapon-capacitor demand and manage the additional heat. A nominal damage increase does not guarantee the same increase in sustained damage: an emptied WEP capacitor, excess heat, reloads, and ammunition limits can interrupt fire. Lower-distributor Blueprints may therefore perform better on a power-constrained loadout.

Compatible Experimental Effects depend on the weapon family. They are selected separately from the Blueprint, and only one may be fitted to a weapon.

== Applying the Blueprint ==

Grades must be progressed in order on each module. The material table lists one roll at each grade; reaching maximum progress can require more than one roll. Once the appropriate Blueprint has been pinned, grade progression can be applied through [[Remote Engineering]]. Installing or changing an Experimental Effect still requires an in-person Engineer workshop visit.
